name: TLS认证、隧道隔离及多客户端
summary: 复用原Go证书和账户/隧道认证，Rust仅接受经授权的generation与lane。

defaults.auth: 账户密码、SNI、离线32B route-key和服务器证书信任；设备/lane标识仍由既有会话管理，无TLS前私有交换。
defaults.auto-ip: client opt-in --auto-ip; server --lease-pool memory-only 7-day original lease; default outer IP MTU remains 1460
defaults.installation-id: client saves only installation ID at --installation-id-file (0600); no persisted IP address

usage.cli: Offline 32B route-key hex or owner-only file; client --tls-ca-pem/OS roots; server --tls-cert and --tls-key; no WB-R1.
usage.config: Single-port authenticated per-device config/IP and generation ownership follow PLAN028; defaults/effective readback are SOURCE-scoped. No TLS-before-ClientHello auto key exchange is permitted.
usage.gui: WinForms dynamic labels include route-key-hex secret plus route-key-hex-file and tls-ca-pem for offline import. Native V4 requires 32B and certificate verification; GUI driver qualification remains source/native scoped, physical NIC switching not yet proven.
